about: The AgentiCCells cluster of newsroom.sgit.ai's article graph (https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/graphs.html), read on 16 November 2026 by viz.places@PrompTugal.dinis: the articles and which link to which (their 'builds on' and 'continued by' threads, taken as undirected links). Summaries are ours, from the graph's own abstracts. Material, not our claims.

nodes.label: PrompTugal.news, the newsroom we ran
nodes.line: Desks of agents that captured, mapped, wrote and reviewed signed articles through Web Summit: the working case.

nodes.label: Starting AgentiCCells
nodes.line: Cells in the customer's own environment, a control centre, everything open, no state kept; a market map found the gap.

nodes.label: Selling mini agentic teams
nodes.line: Teams sized from one agent to a network, a control centre to start and stop them, PrompTugal.news as the first customer.

nodes.label: Six setups of an agentic system
nodes.line: From a single task to conductors of conductors, with command and control growing at each step.

nodes.label: An agentic console
nodes.line: A simulated control room for a team of agentic teams, in a public vault.

nodes.label: Atomic cells, end to end
nodes.line: The website cell: an order, a team that builds a public site, a customer who steers it with a key, a handover.

nodes.label: A hub for agentic sites
nodes.line: Every site a cell builds, in a repository and a vault, listed where it can be found and copied.

nodes.label: Spend fewer tokens
nodes.line: Agents that pre-digest the work so every other agent costs less.

nodes.label: The new data lake
nodes.line: Many small append-only lanes, a curator that turns them into a semantic graph.
